objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving workflows.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The title or identifier of the document, composed of type abbreviation, consecutive number, and descriptive title.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle, including editing, review, released, or out of force.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document.

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The actual text or material of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document becomes valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document expires and requires validity extension check.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Duration for which a document remains valid before requiring revalidation.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which invalidated documents are retained before physical deletion.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document file attached to a main document, subject to the same release cycle and versioning as the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the attachment, aligned with the main document's release process.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the main document's release cycle, released directly without formal approval process.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current publication status of the additional information.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person participating in document management processes with assigned roles and permissions.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identity of the user.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned system role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

attributes.name: user_group
attributes.description: Membership in a group for permission and distribution assignment.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned together for authorization, distribution, or role purposes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier of the user group.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification such as Reader group, Author group, Reviewer group, or Archive group.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A suggested modification to an existing document that does not affect the document's version history until implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the change proposal such as created, scheduled, or completed.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A workflow-controlled request to extend the validity period of an expiring document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the validity extension request.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A workflow-controlled request to invalidate and archive a document no longer in use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the override request.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A workflow-controlled request to restore an invalidated document to active use.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the reactivation request.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A maintained collection of users or user groups assigned to receive document releases or acknowledgement notifications.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification as Distribution by Email or Distribution for Acknowledgement.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature recorded by a workflow participant to document their approval or completion of a document action.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: The user who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: When the signature was recorded.

objs.name: audit_trail
objs.description: A record of all changes and actions performed on a document throughout its lifecycle.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined format for creating new documents of a specific type, containing standard structure and metadata fields.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new document object in the system with selection of document type and optional template selection.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using an editing client and MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Setting and updating document metadata, attributes, and categorized information such as master data and control details.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Designation of read and change permissions to users or user groups for a document.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Specification of a user to perform technical and formal review of document content.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Specification of a user responsible for final approval and release of a document.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of a saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the first workflow step in which the author signs and document is sent to reviewers.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Examination of document content by assigned reviewers against technical and formal criteria.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval by a releaser to publish and distribute a document to intended readers.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by a workflow participant during review or release process.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a released document making it visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic generation of a new editing version when changes are made to a released document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to a new document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Proposal by an authorized employee to amend an existing document without affecting current version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Acceptance and incorporation of a change proposal into a new document version.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Formal extension of a document's validity period through releaser or multi-step approval process.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of a document as out of force through override process, revoking user authorizations.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of an invalidated document to active status with reestablished authorizations and new version.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Language translation of released document content by assigned translator.

evts.name: assign_to_distribution_list
evts.description: Specification of users or user groups to receive document release notifications or acknowledgement requests.

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Automatic notification to distribution list members upon document release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported request for document recipients to actively confirm receipt and understanding.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by a recipient that they have reviewed a distributed document.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Revocation of user authorizations and placement of invalidated document in archive storage.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physical deletion of a document from the system after archive period expiration.

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Reader access to view released documents and associated details through dashboard or direct selection.

o2o.description: A document can reference or link to another document as a related or supporting document.
A document contains one or more attachments that are controlled and versioned with the main document.
A document can have supplementary additional information not subject to main document release cycle.
A change proposal is associated with and proposes amendments to a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to a document requiring revalidation before expiration.
An override request is associated with a document being invalidated and archived.
A document is assigned a distribution list specifying users to receive notifications or acknowledgements.
A document is created using a selected template of the corresponding document type.
A user is assigned membership in one or more user groups.
A user group can have subgroups assigned for specialized distribution or authorization purposes.
Multiple attachments can be associated with a document version.
